newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing Cooperative Bank has $2.71 bln deposits.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Cooperative Bank has $2.71 bln deposits.

text.p: China's Beijing Cooperative Bank had deposits of 22.5 billion yuan ($2.71 billion) at the end of August, up 4.2 billion yuan since the bank opened in January, the Capital Economic Information Daily said on Wednesday.
The bank had outstanding loans totalling 6.7 billion yuan at the end of August, up 2.1 billion yuan since the start of operations on January 8, it said.

The bank had granted loans totalling about 600 million yuan to several key projects and enterprises in Beijing, including the Beijing-Tongxian highway project, Beijing Metal Materials Co and Beijing Mechanical and Electrical Materials Co, it said.
Next year, the bank planned to link all its branch offices with a computer network so that savings could be deposited and withdrawn from all branches, it said.
It was also applying for permission to start foreign currency accounts and grant foreign currency loans, the newspaper said.
